adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces repeated normalization of `destinationCalendar` from a single `DestinationCalendar | null` into a `DestinationCalendar[]` across multiple handlers using similar ternaries, e.g. `bookingReminder.ts` (`selectedDestinationCalendar ? [selectedDestinationCalendar] : []`), Stripe webhook (`packages/features/ee/payments/api/webhook.ts`), PayPal webhook, `confirm.handler.ts`, `editLocation.handler.ts`, `deleteCredential.handler.ts`, `handleCancelBooking.ts`, etc. This is not a correctness defect, but it is a concrete maintainability issue created by the change: duplicated logic increases risk of inconsistent behavior (some return `null`, some `[]`) and future edits needing to touch many call sites. Extracting a shared helper like `getBookingDestinationCalendars(booking, user)` would reduce duplication and enforce consistent semantics.
